title: eludite/nuget/change
description: Install, uninstall, update or consolidate packages (one request shape for the four). The host edits the projects' PackageReference items, or under Central Package Management (ManagePackageVersionsCentrally) the PackageVersion items of Directory.Packages.props and version-less PackageReference items, with MSBuild's construction model (preserving formatting, element order and comments), then restores (unless `restore` is false) with the lock-file rule. A failed restore leaves the edit in place and answers its diagnostics. After a change the solution generation advances (an eludite/solution/status `loaded` carries the new one) and the shell asks for the tree again. Progress and NuGet's output go out as eludite/nuget/update notifications with the call's `operation`.

generation.description: The solution generation the call is issued under (host-rpc.md, "Solution generation"). A value that is not current is -32801; a generation change while the call runs cancels it with -32801.

operation.description: The shell's id for this call (from 1): eludite/nuget/update notifications and eludite/nuget/credentials requests caused by it carry it, so the shell can route the Package Manager output and know who asked.

action.description: install: add the package (or change its version) in each project. uninstall: remove it. update: set each project that references it to `version` (omitted: the newest). consolidate: set every project that references it to `version` (omitted: the highest installed).

packages.description: The packages (Updates' Select All sends several).

version.description: A version (omitted: the newest for install and update, the highest installed for consolidate).

projects.description: Absolute paths of the projects to change. Omitted: install needs them when the solution has more than one project; uninstall, update and consolidate change every project that references the package.

prerelease.description: Include prerelease versions (Visual Studio's "Include prerelease"). Default false.

source.description: A package source's name (its key in NuGet.config). Omitted: every enabled source (Visual Studio's "All").

includeTransitive.description: update and consolidate: a package a project has only transitively gets a top-level reference at the new version (transitive pinning). Default false: only projects that reference it change.

restore.description: Restore after the edit (the setting nuget.restoreOnChange; default true).

lockFiles.description: The setting nuget.lockFiles. respect (the default): when a project has packages.lock.json, a restore that changes nothing runs with `--locked-mode` and a change updates the lock file (`--force-evaluate`); ignore: restore runs without either.

interactive.description: Whether the shell may be asked for credentials (eludite/nuget/credentials) during this call: true for the person's calls, false (the default) for agents', whose calls fail with `credentials_required` instead. Credential providers run either way.

generation.description: The solution generation after the change (one more than the request's when a file was edited).

changes.description: One line per change (`PackageReference Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3 added`).

restore.description: How the restore went. A failed restore leaves an edit in place, as Visual Studio does.

commandLine.description: The `dotnet restore` command line the host ran.

lockedMode.description: Whether `--locked-mode` was used (a lock file existed under `respect` and nothing changed).

lockFiles.description: The packages.lock.json files of the restored projects that exist after the restore.

items.description: A restore error or warning, for the Error List (source `nuget`).

code.description: NuGet's code (NU1101, NU1605, NU1903, ...) or MSBuild's.

file.description: Absolute path of the file the diagnostic is reported against (a project file for NuGet's own).

message.description: Why nothing changed (already at that version, not referenced).
